fusions.name: Lilypad Vault
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles onto an enemy with a toad's hex, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times at full range, and leaving it [Cursed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Croak
fusions.desc: Lets out a croak of arcana that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring resistances, with a 50% chance of [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Film
fusions.desc: Coats you in a slick film of arcana that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wet Hide
fusions.desc: When you take damage that isn't fire, you restore 4 mana. Once every 5 seconds.
